what: [money-path, churn] The standing-wedge ledger refresh is coupled to the operator-ALERT streak, so suppression resumes only after 3 broker-hitting close attempts in a row. Code: close_wedge_standing.observe() is called only from execution_diagnostics.route_close_failure. That is reached only via enqueue_close_failure, which order_monitor._apply_update calls only when _should_alert_close_failure(_close_key, streak) is true: first at MONITOR_CLOSE_FAIL_ALERT_AFTER (default 3), then on its backoff. A market-session defer calls _clear_close_fail_alert_state, which resets the streak, so every closed session restarts the count. MEASURED 2026-09-30 on the live trader (pid 878425, alpaca_paper/GLD pkg-6a8e3fb325464be3), at the 08:00Z pre-market transition. Re-probes at 08:02:06, 08:02:22 and 08:02:51 each still read 'last observed 519 min ago'. Each ran _close_extended_hours: cancel the OCO, POST a 39-share limit, a ~6 s wait, then fail with share_hold broker_cancel_wedged / cancel_accepted_ineffective. Only after the 3rd did 08:03:21 read 'SUPPRESSED … observed 0.3min ago; next probe in 59.7min'. Cost: 2 extra cancel-and-place rounds per closed-session exit on every evidenced wedge. The re-arm sweep also saw 'active close in flight' at 08:02:59. Fix direction: call observe() for every close failure that carries an unclearable share_hold, independent of the alert gate. Keep PAGING on the streak; decouple the LEDGER refresh from it.
